issuingBody: MOFCOM Bureau of Industry Security and Import/Export Control
issuingBodyOriginal: 商务部产业安全与进出口管制局
title: Export-control catalogue and announcements (清单目录)
notes: Publishes the numbered MOFCOM/GACC export-control announcements. Already the origin of Announcements No. 23 (2023) and No. 39 (2023) in the source register. Reachability confirmed 2026-08-11 during watchlist setup; no published review cycle has run yet.

issuingBodyOriginal: 中华人民共和国商务部
title: Policy releases (政策发布)
notes: The main MOFCOM policy-release channel; origin of Announcements No. 18 (2025), No. 10 (2025), No. 33 (2024) and No. 70 (2025). Reachability confirmed 2026-08-11 during watchlist setup.

issuingBody: U.S. Department of the Interior / USGS
title: Federal Register — Interior Department documents
notes: Authoritative channel for critical-minerals list designations; origin of FR Doc. 2025-19813. Reachability confirmed 2026-08-11 during watchlist setup.

issuingBody: U.S. Department of War, Office of Strategic Capital
title: Office of Strategic Capital — news and announcements
notes: Watches US industrial-policy instruments (loans, equity, offtake and price-floor agreements). Listed the OSC release confirming the July 2025 DoD/MP Materials agreement. Uses cto.mil rather than war.gov because war.gov returns 403 to automated clients. Reachability confirmed 2026-08-11 during watchlist setup.

title: Critical Raw Materials Act — implementation pages
notes: Tracks CRMA implementation: strategic-project designations, benchmark reporting and delegated acts. Already in the source register as src-ec-crma. Reachability confirmed 2026-08-11 during watchlist setup.

issuingBody: Japan Organization for Metals and Energy Security (JOGMEC)
issuingBodyOriginal: エネルギー・金属鉱物資源機構
title: JOGMEC news releases (English)
notes: Japan's equity, offtake and stockpiling instruments; origin of the 2023 JOGMEC/JARE–Lynas investment record. Reachability confirmed 2026-08-11 during watchlist setup.

title: Natural Resources Canada news releases (Atom feed)
notes: Machine-readable Atom feed listed on Natural Resources Canada's own RSS page (natural-resources.canada.ca/corporate/rss-feeds). Verified 2026-08-11: returns 50 entries including critical-minerals items. Chosen over the ISED news listing, which times out from the maintainer's network. Caveat: NRCan covers the Critical Minerals Strategy and funding, not Investment Canada Act divestiture orders — the instrument behind the existing Canadian record — so ISED remains an unwatched gap.

issuingBody: Australian Government, Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet
title: Critical Minerals Strategic Reserve
notes: Standing policy page for the Strategic Reserve, updated as the instrument develops. Already in the source register as src-au-pmc-cmsr and verified live by the repository link checker; the host returns 403 to some automated clients.

title: UK Critical Minerals Strategy (publication page)
notes: The live strategy's own publication page, which carries a "last updated" date and lists the technical annex — the surface on which a revision or withdrawal appears first. That is not hypothetical: it is exactly how the 2022 strategy's withdrawal was recorded, and reading it is what established the supersession coded on evt-uk-cms-2022. Quarterly rather than monthly because a strategy page changes on the order of years.

issuingBody: Ministry of Mines, Government of India
title: National Critical Mineral Mission
notes: The Ministry of Mines' own standing page for the Mission. Watched rather than cited: the event record rests on the PIB release (src-pib-ncmm-2025), and this page has not yet been read in full, so it carries no evidentiary weight here. It is the expected surface for the critical-minerals list and the stockpile design the PIB release does not enumerate — the two gaps flagged on that record.
